SessionStart.command: which casen > /dev/null 2>&1 || echo 'BPMNKit plugin: casen CLI not found. Install with: npm install -g @bpmnkit/cli'

hooks.command: FILE=$(node -e "try{const i=JSON.parse(process.env.CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT||'{}');process.stdout.write(i.file_path||i.path||'')}catch{}"); [[ "$FILE" == *.bpmn ]] || exit 0; command -v casen > /dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; OUT=$(casen check "$FILE" --deploy 2>&1) && exit 0; echo "$FILE would not deploy on Camunda 8 (casen check --deploy):" >&2; echo "$OUT" >&2; exit 2
